description: This file defines the 'SampleGridPagerAdapter' class, which manages fragments and backgrounds for a grid view pager in an Android wear application. It creates and manages a list of rows, each containing fragments, and handles asynchronous loading of background images for rows and pages, including transitioning effects.

classes.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing a grid of fragments with background transitions, used in Wear OS grid view paging.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: A container class representing a row composed of multiple fragments.

classes.name: DrawableLoadingTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass to load drawable resources in background and handle transition upon completion.

methods.name: SampleGridPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing rows and backgrounds for the adapter.

methods.name: cardFragment
methods.description: Creates a CardFragment with specified title and text resources.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment at specified row and column.

methods.name: getBackgroundForRow
methods.description: Provides the background drawable for a specific row.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Provides the background drawable for a specific page (row and column).
